annotation.title_clean: The Air Traffic Management and Unmanned Aircraft Act 2021 (Commencement No. 1) Regulations 2021
annotation.title_en: The Air Traffic Management and Unmanned Aircraft Act 2021 (Commencement No. 1) Regulations 2021
annotation.authors_or_issuer: UK Secretary of State for Transport (published by King's Printer of Acts of Parliament)
annotation.summary_en: UK commencement regulations bringing Parts 2 and 3 of the Air Traffic Management and Unmanned Aircraft Act 2021 into force on 29 June 2021, including air traffic services licensing changes and police enforcement powers and fixed penalties for unlawful unmanned aircraft (drone) use.
key_provisions_or_claims: Appoints 29 June 2021 as commencement date for sections 9-11, 13, 15 and several Schedules.
Brings into force police and prison authority powers regarding unmanned aircraft.
Brings into force fixed penalties for certain unmanned aircraft offences.
Updates the regulatory framework for en route air traffic services licensing.
Extends to England and Wales, Scotland and Northern Ireland.
